meta.title: ₹1 LAKH, 10 SAAL KA PLAN: 1 COMPANY YA 20 COMPANIES?
meta.audience: Indian Stock Investors & Gen-Z Wealth Builders
meta.instagramCaption:
₹1 lakh, 10 saal ka plan: sab ek company mein ya 20 mein? 🤔

Dono tareeqe ghalat ho sakte hain!

Asli portfolio banane ke 4 aasaan niyam:
1. Sirf 5-7 solid companies chuno
2. 4 core sectors: Banking, IT, FMCG, Pharma
3. 40-35-25 allocation rule for maximum compounding
4. Saal mein sirf 2 baar check aur rebalance karo!

Aap sabse zyada paisa kahan lagaoge? 👇
Comment karo "BANK", "IT", "FMCG" ya "PHARMA"!

📌 Save karo aur us dost ko bhejo jo investing shuru kar raha hai!

Follow @techwith.GenZ for real wealth secrets!

scenes.headline: ₹1 LAKH, 10 SAAL PLAN
scenes.voice: Agar aapke paas ek lakh rupaye hain aur 10 saal ka plan hai — kya sab ek hi company mein lagayein ya 20 alag alag mein? Dono tareeqe galat hain!

scenes.headline: 4 SECTORS KI FORMULA
scenes.voice: Sirf 5 se 7 solid companies chuno jo in chaar strong sectors mein aati hain: Banking, I-T, FMCG aur Pharma.

scenes.headline: 40-35-25 GOLDEN RULE
scenes.voice: 40 percent Large Cap mein safety ke liye, 35 percent Mid Cap mein growth ke liye, aur bacha 25 percent high potential stocks mein!

scenes.headline: AAP KAUNSA CHUNOGE?
scenes.voice: Aap sabse zyada paisa kahan lagaoge? Comment mein BANK, I-T, FMCG ya PHARMA likho, aur follow karo techwith gen z ko!
